export type FilterType = 'none' | 'grayscale' | 'soft-focus' | 'invert' | 'hue-shift' | 'sepia' | 'dramatic' | 'vibrant';

export interface FilterDefinition {
  id: FilterType;
  label: string;
  sliderLabel: string;
  min: number;
  max: number;
  step: number;
  defaultIntensity: number;
  unit: string;
  getStyle: (val: number) => string;
}

export const FILTERS: FilterDefinition[] = [
  {
    id: 'none',
    label: 'Natural',
    sliderLabel: 'Brightness',
    min: 50,
    max: 150,
    step: 1,
    defaultIntensity: 100,
    unit: '%',
    getStyle: (val) => `brightness(${val}%)`,
  },
  {
    id: 'grayscale',
    label: 'Monochrome',
    sliderLabel: 'Intensity',
    min: 0,
    max: 100,
    step: 1,
    defaultIntensity: 100,
    unit: '%',
    getStyle: (val) => `grayscale(${val}%)`,
  },
  {
    id: 'soft-focus',
    label: 'Soft Focus',
    sliderLabel: 'Bloom',
    min: 0,
    max: 20,
    step: 0.5,
    defaultIntensity: 4,
    unit: 'px',
    getStyle: (val) => `blur(${val}px) contrast(${100 + val * 2}%) saturate(${100 + val}%)`,
  },
  {
    id: 'invert',
    label: 'Inversion',
    sliderLabel: 'Amount',
    min: 0,
    max: 100,
    step: 1,
    defaultIntensity: 100,
    unit: '%',
    getStyle: (val) => `invert(${val}%)`,
  },
  {
    id: 'hue-shift',
    label: 'Hue Shift',
    sliderLabel: 'Degrees',
    min: 0,
    max: 360,
    step: 1,
    defaultIntensity: 180,
    unit: '°',
    getStyle: (val) => `hue-rotate(${val}deg)`,
  },
  {
    id: 'sepia',
    label: 'Vintage',
    sliderLabel: 'Aging',
    min: 0,
    max: 100,
    step: 1,
    defaultIntensity: 80,
    unit: '%',
    getStyle: (val) => `sepia(${val}%)`,
  },
  {
    id: 'dramatic',
    label: 'Noir',
    sliderLabel: 'Contrast',
    min: 100,
    max: 300,
    step: 1,
    defaultIntensity: 180,
    unit: '%',
    getStyle: (val) => `contrast(${val}%) grayscale(100%) brightness(90%)`,
  },
  {
    id: 'vibrant',
    label: 'Pop Art',
    sliderLabel: 'Saturation',
    min: 100,
    max: 400,
    step: 5,
    defaultIntensity: 250,
    unit: '%',
    getStyle: (val) => `saturate(${val}%) contrast(110%)`,
  }
];
